subject: MedFolio: deployment mode & compliance follow-up (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@medfolio.com>, Kelly Tran <kelly.tran@medfolio.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: MedFolio discovery recap + next steps on deployment & evidence

Hi Alicia / Kelly —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we can get your security team the evidence they need and align on the deployment route: 

Summary of the ask:
- MedFolio plans to surface PHI-enriched summarization and charting in an upcoming pilot (care management workflows).
- Priority requirements: HIPAA compliance (BAA), SOC 2 Type II evidence, audit logging retention for 7 years, and the ability to run in a private VPC for the pilot if required.

Redwood deployment options (high level):
1) Hosted API (fastest): Redwood-hosted endpoints; we provide a BAA and SOC 2 Type II report; encryption at rest/in transit. Best for time-to-market.
2) Dedicated capacity: Reserved GPU pools in our cloud tenancy for your account (data isolation + predictable throughput); can include private networking attachments and stricter controls.
3) Private (VPC or on-prem): Customer-controlled VPC or on-prem package with private control plane, integrations with customer KMS/HSM, and audit log forwarding.

Security trade-offs / signals from today's discussion:
- If MedFolio requires KMS key ownership and no cross-tenant disk exposure, Private/VPC or Dedicated with KMS integration is the likely route.
- If tight audit retention (7+ years) is a blocker for hosted logs, we can forward audit logs to your logging account or deploy Private.

Attachments I m sharing here: Redwood SOC2 summary and a BAA template to accelerate legal review. Also attaching a short deployment-options matrix that maps features to each deployment mode.

Next steps (suggested):
1) Kelly/legal: review BAA template (attached) and flag any non-standard clauses by EOD Tue (Dec 8).
2) Alicia/security: confirm whether MedFolio requires customer-held KMS and if audit logs must remain in your account.
3) Technical: if Private/VPC is needed, schedule a 45-minute technical deep-dive with our infra lead (Markus) to confirm network, KMS, and data flow. Markus, Lauren, can you do Dec 9 or 10?
4) I will send the SOC2 Type II summary and a link to our evidence bundle for your security team.

Please reply with availability or any changes to the plan. Happy to adapt.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.ai] | +1 (415) 555-0126
[Attachment: SOC2_TypeII_2024_summary.pdf]
[Attachment: Redwood_BAA_template.docx]
[Attachment: deployment-options-matrix.xlsx]

From: Kelly Tran <kelly.tran@medfolio.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alicia Gomez <agomez@medfolio.com>, MedFolio Security <security@medfolio.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2026 09:17:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MedFolio discovery recap + next steps on deployment & evidence

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear summary. A few clarifications from the legal/security side: 

- We need a standard BAA and we will propose redlines. Please highlight any non-negotiable clauses up front (data residency, deletion windows, subprocessors).
- SOC2 Type II report is good, but our auditors will request the underlying control mappings and some sample evidence (change management tickets, penetration test summaries). Can you confirm whether you can provide redacted artifacts to support the SOC2 claim?
- Regarding KMS: MedFolio s default is customer-managed keys for PHI workloads. If Redwood can integrate with our Cloud KMS in a Dedicated deployment, that would be acceptable; if not, we will expect Private/VPC. 

Also: audit log retention of 7 years is a firm requirement for the pilot. If hosting/log forwarding is non-trivial, we will need a clear timeline for getting logs into our S3 or SIEM.

Can we set the technical deep-dive for Wednesday, Dec 9 at 11:00 PT? I will confirm a second attendee from our infra team.

Regards,
Kelly Tran
Head of Legal & Compliance, MedFolio
kelly.tran@medfolio.com

Kelly —

Great questions. Short answers and commitments below: 

- BAA: the attached Redwood_BAA_template.docx is our standard. We ve flagged the data residency, deletion, and subprocessors clauses. Anything Redwood marks as non-standard is highlighted; we can review redlines in parallel with the deep-dive.
- SOC2 evidence: we can provide redacted artifacts (change logs, sample incident response timeline, pen-test executive summaries). I'll coordinate with our security team to share an evidence bundle via a shared Drive link (I'll send that by end of day Monday).
- KMS: We support customer-managed KMS in Dedicated deployments (we integrate via the cloud provider's key attachments). For full control with no cross-tenant storage, Private/VPC is recommended.
- Audit logs: We can stream audit logs to your SIEM/S3 with guaranteed retention policies. For hosted customers we forward logs; for Dedicated we can set forwarding to a customer-owned bucket. For Private, logs remain in your environment.

Action items I m taking now: 
- Looping in Markus for the technical deep-dive and to prepare the network/KMS checklist.
- Prepare the SOC2 evidence bundle link (expected Mon, Dec 7).
- Confirm Redwood product/hardware constraints for on-prem package (if you want full airgap) and provide rough cost delta estimate post-deep-dive.

Markus / Lauren: available for Dec 9 at 11:00 PT? If not, propose two alternatives.

Thanks,
Jordan
